|rulings=* Works with substituted draws (e.g. a destiny value obtained from [[Smoke Screen]] would count as Light's draw).<ref name="scomp" />
* Modifiers to individual battle destiny draws are applied before comparing them to see which is higher.
* Compare the battle destinies as an automatic action just after both players have finished drawing (or substituting) their one battle destiny.
* Resets opponent's ''total'' battle destiny to an unmodifiable 0.
* Works with [[I Don't Like Sand]] - limits both players to 1 battle destiny draw, then is able to reduce opponent's ''total'' to 0 (the individual draw may not be modified, but the total may be modified).
|combos=* [[Smoke Screen]] - Easily get a high destiny, reducing opponent's total to 0.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Kal%27Falnl%20C%27ndros Scomp: Kal'Falnl C'ndros]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). * [[I Don't Like Sand]] - Cause both players to draw only one battle destiny, setting up KFC. KFC's text does work with Sand, reducing opponent's total to 0.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-kalfalnlcndros-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (18 April 2016): Same words as the previous version. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a white italic “E” at the lower right. The slip replaces the full card image.

Lower part of the previous card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
